hooks.prompt: A source file in src/ was just edited. The stdin JSON contains the file path in tool_input.file_path or tool_response.filePath. Read that file, identify any CRITICAL or HIGH issues only (security vulnerabilities, correctness bugs, race conditions, or data-loss risks). If the file is a test file or has no issues, respond with a single line: 'No critical issues found.' Keep the response under 150 words. Do NOT suggest style improvements or LOW-priority nits.
